title: Seville from our cruise ship on our own.
text: We had a wonderful time with our guide Hector.  He is so pationate about this journey.  He is a wonderful and informative guide.  I would definatley ask for him as your guide.  What a wonderful experience.

title: Great Tour at Seville Cathedral
text: Our Tour guide Hector was very friendly and knowledgeable about the Cathedral and Castle. He was great ! We appreciated his enthusiasm.

title: Great tour of the cathedral
text: Hector was an excellent guide. He was very knowledgeable in his tour and gave us a very well timed visit of the cathedral. The tempo was good, the history was accurate and clear and all was very well explained. Great tour.
